_comment: Authoring lane: the invitations-sent state of Distribution. Identical to authoring-meridiano.json except GET /surveys/{id}/invitations. The local survey has no invitations and creating them is a write, so every row is a SurveyInvitationDetail (web/src/features/surveys/api/surveyDistribution.ts:149) filled from a real GET /admin/users row of the survey's five departments, status "sent" (SurveyInvitationStatuses.cs), ids uuid5 of the survey and user; the summary is counted from the rows and the anonymity block is the real payload's.
